entities.text:
High Court Of Punjab & Haryana
 At Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
J. 
Present petition has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of
anticipatory bail in Fir No.0523 dated 04.09.2022, under Sections 272, 273, 420, 467, 468, 471 of
Ipc registered at Police Station Palla, District Faridabad.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in pursuance of order dated 09.01.2023, of this Court, the petitioner has not only joined investigation but has also fully cooperated with the investigating agency.
He further submits that in case the investigating agency requires the petitioner to appear, he shall make himself available without demur.
Learned State counsel on instructions from ASI Jamil Khan affirms the factum of joining the investigation by the petitioner and cooperating with the investigation agency.
He also submits that at this stage, the petitioner is not required for further custodial interrogation.

In view of the above and without expressing any opinion on the 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:032738 CRM-M-719-2023 (O&M) -2- merits of the case, anticipatory bail petition filed by the petitioner is allowed and the order dated 09.01.2023 granting interim bail to him, is hereby made absolute, subject to compliance of conditions as specified under Section 438(2) Cr.
